papers_read.title_as_printed: Predicting cognitive decline: Deep-learning reveals subtle brain changes in pre-MCI stage (Yue, Pan, Li et al., J Prev Alz Dis 2025)
Predicting long-term progression of Alzheimer's disease using a multimodal deep learning model incorporating interaction effects (Wang et al., J Transl Med 2024)

what_each_reports.P-146: Conversion from normal cognition (NC/SCD) to amnestic MCI. On CLAS (n=109, ~7-year follow-up) the MRI-derived Progressive Index alone gives AUC 0.711; PI combined with age, gender, education and an associative-learning score gives AUC 0.812 (95% CI 0.725-0.900). On ADNI-2 NC/SCD (NC-to-MCI within 3 years) the PI gives AUC 0.7048.
what_each_reports.P-273: Conversion from MCI to AD within 4 years in ADNI-1/GO/2 MCI patients (n=238 cross-validation): trimodal (sMRI + clinical/neuropsychological + SNP) DISFC model, mean AUC 0.962 (SD 0.041) over tenfold CV; AUC 0.939 (95% CI 0.796-1.000) on 14 ADNI-3 MCI subjects.

quantity_a: ROC-AUC for predicting progression from cognitively normal/SCD to MCI over ~7 years in a Chinese community cohort (CLAS), from an ADNI-1-trained MRI index plus demographics and one neuropsychological score (0.812); secondarily NC/SCD-to-MCI within 3 years in ADNI-2 (0.7048)
quantity_b: ROC-AUC for predicting progression from MCI to AD within 4 years in ADNI MCI patients, from sMRI + 14 clinical/cognitive features + 49 SNPs, tenfold cross-validation (0.962)
incompatible_if_same: Possibly: 0.812 (CI 0.725-0.900) does not overlap a CV mean of 0.962, but the ADNI-3 test CI of P-273 (0.796-1.000) overlaps it; the comparison is moot because the endpoints and populations differ.

gates.task: mismatch: both coded T2 (progression), but P-146 predicts NC/SCD-to-MCI conversion and P-273 predicts MCI-to-AD conversion; different transitions
gates.dataset_family: mismatch for the contested figure: 0.812 is from CLAS (Shanghai community cohort), 0.962 from ADNI; P-146's own ADNI result (ADNI-2, NC-to-MCI) is 0.7048 and is not the claimed figure
gates.validation_tier: mismatch: P-146 applies an ADNI-1-trained model to independent ADNI-2 and CLAS cohorts (external), P-273's 0.962 is internal tenfold CV (its 14-subject ADNI-3 test gives 0.939)
gates.modality_family: partial match: both structural MRI plus clinical variables; P-273 additionally uses SNP genotypes

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: same metric type (ROC-AUC) but different endpoints (MCI onset from normal cognition over 7 years vs AD onset from MCI over 4 years) and different baseline populations
performance_validity: flag does not apply: neither value is >= 0.97; P-273's 0.962 is internal CV with small n but below the threshold
independence: Distinct studies and author groups (both Shanghai Jiao Tong affiliations but no shared authors); both draw training data from ADNI-1, so ADNI overlap exists for P-146's training set and P-273's cohort, but the contested P-146 figure is on CLAS
grounds: P-146's 0.812 is an NC-to-MCI conversion AUC in the CLAS community cohort, not an MCI-to-AD figure.
P-273's 0.962 is an MCI-to-AD conversion AUC within 4 years in ADNI MCI patients.
The two transitions have different baseline populations and endpoints, and the dataset-family gate fails for the contested figure (CLAS vs ADNI) with no waiver on record.
The record's claim_a attributes the figure to P-310, which has been repointed to P-146; the figure does belong to P-146 but was never an MCI-to-AD result.

evidence_quotes.quote: Better performance for prediction progression to MCI in CLAS was obtained when the PI score was combined with clinical measures (AUC = 0.812; 95 %CI: 0.725-0.900).
Among 109 cognitively normal subjects (33NC and 76 SCD at baseline), 16 NC and 24 SCD showed clinical progression to amnestic MCI at follow-up.
The AUC value was 0.7048, and the SPE and SEN were 0.6667 and 0.6897 (with the threshold of the overall average score).
On the cross-validation set, the DISFC model achieved a mean (SD) of 0.962 (0.041) for AUC for predicting MCI conversion over 4 years (Fig. 3A).
The cross-validation set consisted of 238 MCI subjects from ADNI-1 and ADNI-GO/2 cohorts, with a 48-month follow-up.

record_defects: claim_a still names P-310 ('P-310: AUC 0.812 on T2') although paper_a was repointed to P-146; the 0.812 figure is P-146's CLAS result.
dataset_family_equivalence: true is wrong for the contested figure: 0.812 is from CLAS, not ADNI.
validation_tier_comparable: true is doubtful: P-146's figure is on an independent cohort while P-273's 0.962 is internal CV.
Registry row for P-146 has Best_Metric 'not reported' although the paper reports AUC 0.812, 0.711 and 0.7048.
resolution_note's bridging list mixes C-index, accuracy and AUC values from unrelated tasks as 'comparable task/dataset family'.
what_would_change_the_verdict: A P-146 result for MCI-to-AD conversion in ADNI (none is reported; its ADNI-1 training used AD/pMCI vs NC/sMCI labels without a reported MCI-to-AD test AUC).
